_what_this_is: What the algorithms learned about the substrate they run on. Written by any algorithm, read by all of them. algorithms.json says what each algorithm IS; this says what each one LEARNED.
_the_rule: every memory carries who learned it, from what evidence, and what other algorithms should do differently because of it. A memory with no implication is a note, and notes are not machine-actionable.

_kinds.INSTRUMENT: a log, table or channel and how far it can actually see
_kinds.SUBSTRATE: how the system behaves under load — timeouts, drops, limits
_kinds.CARRIER: a column or object that does or does not carry what it claims
_kinds.TRAP: a way of reading the data that produces a confident wrong answer

memories.subject: cdhdr
memories.fact: the change-document header extract is a FILTERED SUBSET. It carries 57 object classes; cdhdr_history carries 72. Missing from cdhdr: PBC, SETS, SUSR_PROF and every custom Y* class.
memories.evidence: 57 vs 72 distinct OBJECTCLAS; PBC's 3.4M changes absent from cdhdr entirely
memories.implication: NEVER answer 'who changed this' from cdhdr alone. Read cdhdr_history too and reconcile. An object absent from cdhdr has not necessarily stopped changing — it may simply not be in this extract.

memories.subject: cdhdr_history
memories.fact: the fuller change log: 72 object classes, 2024-01-01 to 2026-06-20, and the ONLY store carrying PBC, SETS (hierarchy maintenance), SUSR_PROF (authorisation profiles) and the custom Y* change-document objects.
memories.evidence: 12,029,963 rows; classes present here and absent from cdhdr: 15
memories.implication: this is the default change instrument, not the fallback. Hierarchy and authorisation questions can ONLY be answered here.

memories.subject: P01.rfc_session
memories.fact: the connection degrades and drops after roughly a dozen calls, and a wide read hangs
memories.evidence: observed across the log accumulator and the P01 source extractor
memories.implication: chunk every temporal read to <=6h windows and reconnect on COMMUNICATION_FAILURE / 'partner not reached' rather than treating it as a real answer. A silently truncated window looks like a quiet period.

memories.subject: _query_shape
memories.fact: resolving row-by-row in Python what could be aggregated in SQL first is the single most expensive mistake available here — measured at 548x on one rewrite
memories.evidence: A8 runtime >1h -> 3m29s after pre-aggregating 15.6M audit rows into 987K slots
memories.implication: aggregate with GROUP BY, then resolve the small result. A correlated subquery over a multi-million-row fact table is not a query, it is a scan per row.

memories.subject: fmifiit_full.MEASURE
memories.fact: Funded Program — SAP's designed WBS-to-FM bridge — is declared and blank in every row. So are FAREA, GRANT_NBR and PRCTR. The FM ledger posts on exactly two legs: Fund x Fund Center.
memories.evidence: 0 populated of 2,308,814 rows for MEASURE, FAREA, GRANT_NBR, PRCTR
memories.implication: no query may join FM actuals to work through MEASURE. Any analysis that needs 'which project consumed this' must reconstruct it by identifier grammar, and must say so.

memories.subject: prps.POSID
memories.fact: the WBS identifier CARRIES the chain the schema does not: its root before the first dot is the fund code, and its dot depth is its hierarchy level. 99.5% of WBS elements resolve to a real fund this way.
memories.evidence: 59,424 of 59,749 roots match funds.FINCODE; depth runs 1..7
memories.implication: the fund-to-work link is reconstructable without Funded Program. Use root(POSID). And note depth >4 exists (2,046 elements), so any code assuming the designed 4-level spine will mis-handle them.

memories.subject: funds.FINCODE
memories.fact: three code grammars coexist in one field and the grammar predicts the fund TYPE family: all-numeric (73%) = RP/staff types 0xx, NNN+GEO+NNNN (21%) = extrabudgetary delivery types 1xx, and legacy alpha-prefixed variants.
memories.evidence: 56,752 UNES funds over 30 shapes; TYPE concentration >=50% within the top shapes
memories.implication: the identifier is a classification, not a label. Any filter, grouping or sample that ignores the grammar mixes populations that have nothing to do with each other.

memories.subject: FMFINCODE
memories.fact: the fund-master change-document class carries ZERO records in either change log, while the fund master holds 67,526 funds
memories.evidence: 0 rows for OBJECTCLAS='FMFINCODE' in cdhdr and cdhdr_history
memories.implication: who creates and changes funds cannot be answered from the change log at all. Fall back to A8 attribution against the execution log — it is the only instrument left for the most heavily populated master in the model.

memories.subject: YFMFUNDC5
memories.fact: a CUSTOM change-document object exists for the custom fund-to-C/5 bridge table, and it appears only in cdhdr_history
memories.implication: custom carriers can have custom instruments. Discover change-document classes by name affinity against the table rather than assuming the standard SAP list is complete.

memories.subject: fmavct.RCMMTITEM
memories.fact: the availability-control object collapses the commitment-item leg: at 63.7% of Fund x Fund Center addresses, several distinct commitment items arrive at a single grouped bucket
memories.evidence: 5,949 addresses compared; 3.99 FIPEX in vs 1.48 RCMMTITEM out
memories.implication: availability is checked on a SHARED pool. Never report 'this cost category had budget' from AVC — the bucket is shared, so consumption by one category silently reduces headroom for its neighbours.

memories.subject: prps -> funds
memories.fact: this link resolves at 99.5% through STRING PREFIX of POSID, NOT through the designed FMMEASURE / Funded Program derivation via FMDERIVE
memories.implication: join through the actual carrier and say so. Anyone reading the data model will look for the designed one and find nothing.

memories.subject: proj -> funds
memories.fact: this link resolves at 98.8% through STRING IDENTITY (PSPID = FINCODE), NOT through the designed none — Fund and Project are meant to be independent dimensions
memories.implication: join through the actual carrier and say so. Anyone reading the data model will look for the designed one and find nothing.

memories.subject: prps -> proj
memories.fact: this link resolves at 99.8% through same, plus the string root agrees, NOT through the designed PRPS.PSPHI -> PROJ.PSPNR (the real SAP foreign key)
memories.implication: join through the actual carrier and say so. Anyone reading the data model will look for the designed one and find nothing.

memories.subject: funds
memories.fact: change visibility for this object is DECLARED_BUT_EMPTY (FMFINCODE)
memories.implication: the change-document object is part of the design and carries no records in any log here — changes to this object leave no trace

memories.subject: ytfm_fund_c5
memories.fact: change visibility for this object is OBSERVABLE_IN_ONE_LOG_ONLY (YFMFUNDC5)
memories.implication: present in cdhdr_history and absent from cdhdr — anyone querying the wrong log concludes this object never changes
